verdict.rationale: Government digital services such as the FTB's MyFTB and Web Pay could plausibly publish their source under an open license, so this axis applies. The evidence pack contains only two edge-denial probes (HTTP 403 at robots.txt and at the webapp host). Nothing shows any published source repository or open license, so absent evidence yields none.
